# title: Λυσιστράτη (Lysistrata)
description: Aristophanes' Lysistrata by the National Theatre of Northern Greece (KTHVE), translated by Konstantinos Bouras and adapted and directed by Asterios Peltekis, with music by Giorgos Andreou and choreography by Konstantinos Rigos. # title: Δαιμόνια στο ρέμα (Demons in the Stream)
venue: Skini Omega, Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, Piraeus
description: A stage composition on texts by Alexandros Papadiamantis by the Kallitechnikoi Dialogoi company under the aegis of the Society for Papadiamantis Studies, adapted and directed by Maria Frangi, with Nerina Zarpa, Manolis Zacheilas, Tassos Ziakkas, Tasos Blatzios and Frangi herself, and shadow theatre by Dimitris Maroudas; music Zacheilas, songs Anna Mouzaki, sets and costumes Sandra Stefanidou. description: Bernard-Marie Koltès's last play in Dimitris Dimitriadis's translation, directed by Dimitris Karantzas, with Dimitris Kapouranis in the title role and Manolis Mavromatakis, Anna Kalaitzidou, Dimitra Vlagopoulou, Michalis Titopoulos, Ioanna Demertzidou, Babis Alefantis and Vasilis Zafeiropoulos. A young man kills his parents and drifts through a city of interchangeable roles, the girl, the mother, the policeman, in an episodic story drawn from the real case of the Italian killer Roberto Succo. Saturdays at 18:00 and 21:15; runs to 1 November; 18€ students, unemployed, children, disabled and large families, 14€ restricted view.

# title: Η Δίκη (The Trial)
description: Aris Biniaris's staging of Kafka's The Trial returns to Theatro Ark for a second season after a sold-out first year, with Odysseas Papaspiliopoulos as Josef K. A bank clerk is arrested one morning without being told his crime and is drawn into a court whose rules nobody explains; Biniaris treats it as a descent into surveillance, discipline and internalised guilt, with dramaturgy by Sofia Eftychiadou and music by Jeff Wagner. Also with Evita Agaitsi, Alexis Vidalakis, Angeliki Delithanasi, Vasilis Kazis, Konstantinos Maglaras, Klearchos Papageorgiou, Stefanos Pittas, Sotiris Tsakomidis, Nikolas Chatzivasileiadis and Kostas Phoenix. 90 minutes, in Greek; from 28 October to 20 December; 23€ – 25€, 20€ students, unemployed, over 65 and low-ceiling seats; Wednesday and Sunday at 20:00, Thursday to Saturday at 21:00, Saturday also at 18:00.

Tierra
venue: Theatro tou Neou Kosmou, Central Stage, Neos Kosmos
description: Sergio Blanco's Tierra in its Greek premiere, directed by Vangelis Theodoropoulos for the 30th-anniversary season of Theatro tou Neou Kosmou, translated by Maria Chatziemmanouil. An autofiction written after the death of the Uruguayan author's mother, the Hellenist and poet Liliana Ayestarán, in 2022, on earth, burial, grief and what writing can do with loss, told through three students. With Syrmo Keke, Odysseas Makris, Aris Balis and Maria Tsima. In Greek; the first two performances on 29 and 31 October are previews at 9€, thereafter 20€, 18€ for unemployed, disabled, students, over 65 and large families.

Θαυμαστός Καινούριος Κόσμος (Brave New World)
description: Aldous Huxley's Brave New World adapted for the stage by Elena Triantafyllopoulou and directed by Aikaterini Papageorgiou at Theatro Dipylon. A society keeps itself stable through engineered births, conditioning and prescribed happiness, and control works through consumption rather than force. With Isidora Doropoulou, Anastasia Rafaela Konidi, Marios Kritikopoulos, Tasos Lekkas, Kallirroi Myriagkou and Vasilis Milionis. In Greek; opens 29 October and runs to 20 December, Thursday to Saturday at 21:00 and Sunday at 20:00; 20€, 18€ students, unemployed and over 65.

Ο Βυσσινόκηπος (The Cherry Orchard)
description: Chekhov's The Cherry Orchard in Marios Ploritis's translation, directed by Sofia Spyratou, with Katia Dandoulaki as Ranevskaya in her return to the stage of her own theatre. A landowning family comes home to an estate that must be sold to pay its debts and cannot bring itself to act while the orchard is auctioned. Also with Meletis Ilias, Leonidas Kakouris, Takis Papamatthaiou, Ioanna Asimakopoulou, Christos Plainis, Evgenia Xygkorou, Nancy Boukli, Charis Fleouras, Giorgos Nousis, Antonis Karnavas and Katiana Balanika; sets Konstantinos Skourletis, music Stefanos Korkolis. In Greek; from 30 October; 25€ – 35€ by zone, 20€ – 25€ students, unemployed, disabled and children, the first 50 tickets 20€; Wednesday and Sunday 19:30, Thursday 20:00, Friday 21:00, Saturday 18:00 and 21:00.
